value.rationale: The universal all-m rate-balance frontier rigorously separates failure of hub holding probability from loss of leaf-to-leaf transport in an important standard RK time integrator for reversible nonuniform-stationary Markov systems. It gives the exact maximal safe completed timestep for every positive a,b and arbitrary number of leaves, with dimension-free switch and explicit asymptotic/mechanism interpretation. Such a sharp classification is a useful numerical-analysis boundary and not merely a renamed SSP bound, arbitrary one-off case or known undirected-table recomputation; scope and priority risks stated.
